entities.name: Jacob Markström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jacob Anders Markström is a Swedish professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the New Jersey Devils of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Florida Panthers in the second round, 31st overall, of the 2008 NHL entry draft. He previously played for the Panthers, Vancouver Canucks, and Calgary Flames.
